Category tree

All Products at the top, two departments below it, each with its categories. The GA4 category path carries the whole branch; in fashion occasion and length sit below the category, home pieces stop at it. Categories are where products are offered, not a signal about the shopper: what the shopper opens, views and buys is.

Dimensions

The taste dimensions (pkg/internal/mock/taste) the products' attractors use, by department. Dresses and trousers speak the same ones, so taste carries between them. Home decoration shares only some, so what the shop learns from clothes reaches it only through those.

All Products

The top of the tree, every product the shop sells. It has no weights of its own: every product in it is scored in its own category's weights (catalog.Score). Each category's weights average ×1, so they set emphasis, not scale, and a listing of all products ranks a dress against a lamp on one scale.
